notes.title: Language fixes in latest Update
notes.content:
Some astute players pointed out some typos and grammatical errors in the previous build of Destiny Warriors.

These have been fixed.

We're always eager to hear your feedback (good and bad), as it helps us enhance the stuff you like and fix the stuff you don't.

Thanks.
